articles.summary: Michael Patterson, Chief Research Officer at Radius Insights shares how AI is transforming market research and what it means for the future of the industry. Michael previously founded Probeit, an independent market research firm that was acquired by Radius Insights. With a PhD in experimental psychology from TCU, Michael brings a unique blend of academic rigor, statistical expertise, and technological understanding to market research.
articles.title: From Founder to AI Market Research Pioneer: How Michael Patterson is Reshaping the Industry with AI
